title: bulk redact API
body: lots of requests for bulk redaction support after FN spambot attacks over christmas. plus we probably need it for GDPR too. It could be as simple as 'redact all messages from this user' for now.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
> we probably need it for GDPR too

b-b-but event content still stays in database after redaction.

also again this: https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/1621#issuecomment-269857023

comments.body:
related: https://github.com/vector-im/riot-web/issues/3689

Might make sense to use this issue to track "redact all messages from this user", and the other issue for selecting multiple messages to redact.
